positions.title: Ex Officio Graduate Board Member and former Vice President
positions.description:
Trained and managed the officer corps of over 20 student officers.
Increased recruitment of new members in both 2019 and 2020.
Facilitated communication between club members, officers, as well as the governing Graduate Board. Involved tasks such as managing schedules, planning events, and solving problems when they arise.
Current membership on the Graduate Board to mentor current officers, managing digital communications, and maintain membership.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Provided technical assistance and problem solving with projects for three client teams and one internal team. Worked as a full stack web .NET developer in SQL, C Sharp and Javascript. Example projects include improving the speed of a key SQL query by an factor of ten, contributing to a new REST API platform, and optimizing the upload of large files to Amazon Web Services by a factor of 5-10 entries. Additionally worked as a liaison between a client team and our DevOps team to communicate technical specifications and develop design ideas.

positions.title: Designer
positions.description: Inter-Cultura is a consulting firm focused on human-centered design and innovation. As a Designer, my independent project was to investigate and improve the firm’s onboarding process. This process involved conducting interviews, researching contemporary onboarding practices, and then creating a prototype and suggestions for how to proceed.

positions.title: Social Impact Designer
positions.description: Tiger Challenge is a program that helps students apply design thinking for social innovation.  My team works with the municipality of Princeton, NJ for their Bloomberg Mayors Challenge Project 2018 to develop a closed-loop food system to address the issue of food waste. We develop techniques based in behavioral science to help residents sort their waste properly. For example, we test different ways to communicate with residents and correct behavior through emails and social media, as well as how to encourage non-voluntary citizens to participate for environmental and economic reasons.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: I work primarily with high school students in STEM subjects.  I help nurture their study and test-taking skills, and I communicate with parents about their child's needs.

educations.degreeName: Bachelor of Science in Engineering - BSE

volunteerExperiences.description: I worked with aquarium guests in a variety of capacities. I primarily worked in individual exhibits, educating guests on ocean life and conservation. I also worked as an aquarium representative at the welcome desk and with families during birthday parties.
As a student at Campbell High School, I volunteered at Dowell Elementary School as a Spanish interpreter for parent-teacher conferences.
